name: Andover Climate Lobby
description: Student initiative of the Phillips Academy Sustainability Coalition that takes students to the Massachusetts State House to lobby legislators to co-sponsor climate bills.

name: LORAX at Milton Academy
description: Student environmental group at Milton Academy, founded in 1987, that raises ecological awareness and promotes responsible practices on campus through discussion and education.

name: Greenroots Environmental Chelsea Organizers Youth Crew
description: Youth leadership program of GreenRoots in Chelsea where high school students run environmental justice campaigns on water quality, heat, murals and youth organizing.

description: UMass Amherst chapter of the student-run MASSPIRG, active since 1972, with campaigns on campus renewable energy, pollinators, textbook costs and voter registration.

name: Extinction Rebellion Youth
description: Youth counterpart of Extinction Rebellion Massachusetts for people 18 and under, using nonviolent direct action to demand government action on the climate emergency.

events.name: Bird Research in Action: Bird Banding at Wellfleet Bay
Early Bird Walk at Wellfleet Bay

name: Citizens Awareness Network
description: Grassroots group, founded in 1991, that works to end nuclear power in the Northeast and replace it with renewable, affordable energy, through education, community action and legislative advocacy.

events.name: Press Conference and Demonstration at New England Regional Nuclear Policy Summit

projects: No Deal to Repeal: Save Chapter 503
actions: Write and call the conference committee to save Chapter 503

name: Franklin County Continuing the Political Revolution Climate Crisis Task Force
description: Climate working group of Franklin County Continuing the Political Revolution (a Greenfield-based grassroots political group) that pushes for policy changes on energy, consumption and jobs to end fossil fuel dependence.

projects: Mass Power Forward legislative agenda support

name: Kearsarge Energy
description: Boston-based company that develops, owns and operates solar and battery storage projects for public entities, with over 70 projects in Massachusetts.

name: October Engineering LLC
description: One-person energy engineering firm in Sudbury run by a licensed professional engineer that offers free residential electrification, heat pump and ventilation design consulting.

name: Solar Design Associates
description: Solar installation, design and engineering firm in Harvard, MA, founded in 1974, serving New England.

Sign up for a no-cost home energy assessment

description: Climate and clean energy advocacy organization that works on building and transportation electrification and clean energy policy across the Northeast, with an office in Boston.

projects: Acadia Center Massachusetts Climate and Energy Policy Work
actions: Contact your state legislators about climate policy

name: Citizens' Climate Lobby - North Shore Chapter
description: North Shore chapter of Citizens' Climate Lobby that builds public support for climate action and lobbies members of Congress for bipartisan climate legislation.

name: Metropolitan Area Planning Council
description: Public regional planning agency for the 101 cities and towns of Greater Boston, founded in 1963, whose work includes climate resilience and sustainability planning.

name: Vermont Conservation Voters
description: Statewide political voice for the environment in Montpelier that endorses candidates, tracks votes, and convenes the annual Environmental Common Agenda. Founded in 1982.

actions: Volunteer for the Community Canvass Tour (with VPIRG)

name: Vermont Climate & Health Alliance
description: Network of Vermont physicians, nurses, therapists, veterinarians and other health professionals who inform the public and lawmakers about climate change and health and push for a fast shift off fossil fuels.

name: Preservation Trust of Vermont
description: Montpelier-based historic preservation nonprofit; a partner on the Environmental Common Agenda and an Energy Action Network member.

name: Public Assets Institute
description: Montpelier nonprofit providing tax, budget and economic data and analysis to advance equitable policies; an Energy Action Network member.

name: Vermont Housing & Conservation Board
description: Montpelier board that invests in permanently affordable housing and land conservation; an Energy Action Network member.

name: Citizens' Climate Lobby - Vermont At Large
description: Active Citizens' Climate Lobby chapter covering Vermont outside greater Burlington and the Upper Valley; volunteers meet with elected officials to build support for climate laws.

name: Building Performance Professionals Association of Vermont
description: Trade association of Vermont building-performance and weatherization professionals.

name: Northern Forest Center
description: Regional nonprofit working across the Northern Forest on rural community development, wood-based energy and markets, and outdoor recreation, with Vermont staff and projects in the Northeast Kingdom.

name: Vermont Independent Power Producers Association
description: Trade association of independent power producers in Vermont.

name: Williston Energy Committee
description: Volunteer town committee in Williston that promotes energy saving, weatherization, electric vehicles and window-insert builds, and helped organize the 2026 Williston Green Fair.

name: Starksboro Energy Committee
description: Town committee working with residents, businesses and the town on long-term energy independence, including benchmarking town buildings and offering free energy-savings kits.

name: 350Chittenden County Node
description: 350Vermont node of activists who meet regularly and host events in the Burlington area to educate and organize for climate justice.

name: Vermont Racial Justice Alliance
description: Black-led Vermont organization working to dismantle systemic racism through organizing, education, policy and wellness programs; it signed the 2022 letter supporting Vermont's environmental justice law and has published a Justice Agenda tied to climate action.
